faq.q: How do I install Genshin Impact on Android?
faq.a: Open Google Play, search for Genshin Impact and check the developer is COGNOSPHERE PTE. LTD. before tapping Install. It needs Android 6.0 or newer. It's free to install, and Play keeps it updated automatically. Avoid copies from other sites: they aren't from COGNOSPHERE PTE. LTD. and may be altered, so the safest way to play Genshin Impact is the official listing.

Yes. Genshin Impact is free to download and play, with no ads. In-app purchases from $0.99 to $99.99 per item on Google Play buy Genesis Crystals for wishes, the Welkin Moon pass and the Battle Pass. You can finish the story without paying.

faq.q: What phone do I need for Genshin Impact?
faq.a: Google Play lists Android 6.0 or newer, but the game is demanding. For smooth play you need a recent phone with a strong processor, plenty of RAM and tens of gigabytes of free storage, because the full game and its updates are very large.

faq.q: Can I play Genshin Impact with friends?
faq.a: Yes. Once you reach Adventure Rank 16, co-op lets up to four players explore, fight bosses and complete domains together. Genshin also supports cross-play and cross-save with PC and PlayStation through a HoYoverse account.

faq.q: How do wishes and pity work in Genshin?
faq.a: Wishes are Genshin's gacha banners, where you spend currency for a random character or weapon. A pity system guarantees a 5-star item within 90 wishes on character banners, and the next 5-star is guaranteed to be the featured character if you missed it last time.
